tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background, inputs and dialogs. Also the text colour on an accent fill (primary button): 6.2:1 light, 7.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: the header bar, flash messages, code blocks and default buttons.

tokens.name: tag
tokens.usage: Fill behind a tag (unverified, notice, workspace and mode).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table rows, header rules, fieldset and dialog edges. Decorative only: 1.3:1, too faint to outline a control on its own.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, panel and tag (11.7:1 or more in both themes). Also the fill of a count badge and the current view in a switch, with bg text.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, panel and tag: hints, table headers, labels, timestamps that say 'never' (4.9:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, the primary button's fill, focus rings and the current section's underline. Reads on bg, panel and tag (5.4:1 or more). Never a status colour.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success: a done flash's edge, the read delivery state, the live dot. Text on bg, panel and tag (4.7:1 or more). Always with a word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution: the unverified tag on handles. Text on bg, panel and tag (4.5:1 or more). Always with a word.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Danger and failure: danger buttons, blocked and expired states, error flashes. Text on bg, panel and tag (5.7:1 or more). Always with a word.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: The outline of inputs, buttons and tags you can remove: 3:1 or more against bg and panel, which line isn't.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Behind search matches (<mark>), always with fg text: 13.7:1 light, 8.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Behind an open confirm dialog.

tokens.name: console-bg
tokens.usage: The audit log's terminal: panel-light in light mode, near-black in dark.

tokens.name: console-line
tokens.usage: Rules inside the terminal, and the line under the pointer or open.

tokens.name: console-fg
tokens.usage: Terminal text: 15:1 or more light, 11.9:1 or more dark, on console-bg and console-line.

tokens.name: console-muted
tokens.usage: Terminal times, actors and detail keys (4.9:1 or more light, 5.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: console-accent
tokens.usage: Links in the terminal.

tokens.name: console-ok
tokens.usage: Good outcomes in the terminal.

tokens.name: console-warn
tokens.usage: Events that let more in or need a look: a widened policy, an unblock, an expiry (4.5:1 or more light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: console-bad
tokens.usage: Events that refused or removed something: a refused message, a block, a revoked sign-in (5.7:1 or more light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: op-bar
tokens.usage: The operator console's header, in both themes, so it can't be taken for a workspace's pages.

tokens.name: op-bar-fg
tokens.usage: Text on op-bar: 14.4:1.

tokens.name: op-bar-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and the other sections on op-bar: 9.1:1.

tokens.name: op-bar-line
tokens.usage: Rules on op-bar, and behind the initial in its account menu.

tokens.name: op-bar-mark
tokens.usage: On op-bar: the current section's underline and the Console tag's border.

tokens.name: security
tokens.usage: The console's Security tag on settings that decide who can get in or what leaves the server, on security-bg: 7.6:1 light, 8.9:1 dark. Not a status: it marks what to check, not what's wrong.

tokens.name: security-bg
tokens.usage: Behind the Security tag.

tokens.name: secret
tokens.usage: The console's Secret tag on settings whose values are never shown, on secret-bg: 6.6:1 light, 9.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: secret-bg
tokens.usage: Behind the Secret tag.

tokens.name: set
tokens.usage: The console's Set tag, on a setting given a value in .env rather than left at its default, on set-bg: 6.6:1 light, 9.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: set-bg
tokens.usage: Behind the Set tag.

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: No longer used: the header shows the logo (budd-wordmark, 24px tall; see the README's Look section), not "Budd" in type.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: h1: one per page, naming what the page is about.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: h2: sections of a page and dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Blocked chatgpt. Its tool calls now fail and nobody can message it.
styles.usage: All running text, table cells and controls.

styles.name: emphasis
styles.usage: Emphasis within running text: the workspace name, the current section, a row's title, unread states and counts, the destroy button.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Anything the person might type or match exactly: connection names, handles, ids, commands, message bodies.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: a tag's margin, a label's vertical margin, h1's top margin.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside code blocks and fieldsets; space under h2.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Header bar's vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter, gaps between nav links, space under h1 and between blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between header groups and space above h2.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Code blocks and fieldsets.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: The widest a page's main column grows: the whole window. Paragraphs and fields keep their own limits.

tokens.name: group-max
tokens.usage: The widest a group or a notice grows: the page's width.

tokens.name: text-max
tokens.usage: The widest a paragraph grows, so lines stay readable.

tokens.name: wide-max
tokens.usage: A standalone page with a form to read (connecting an app).

tokens.name: dialog-max
tokens.usage: The widest a dialog grows.

tokens.name: narrow-max
tokens.usage: A standalone page (sign in, create a login).

tokens.name: field-max
tokens.usage: The widest a text field grows; also the thread list.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: The height of buttons, inputs, selects and the view switch. 44px on phones (40rem and under), for touch.
